name: South Atlantic Digital Gateway (SADG)
notes: MissionNEX official SADG page describes a commercially operated South Atlantic space-ground/telecommunications hub with secure data centers, licensed earth stations, construction start anticipated in 2026 and initial operations anticipated in 2027. FITV search result reports JETstreaM Ltd plans antennas near Pony's Pass Quarry; Falkland Islands Government identifies Pony's Pass Quarry as five miles southwest of Stanley, so classified under Camp. Capacity MW not published.

name: Sure South Atlantic enterprise data hosting/data centres
notes: Official Sure Falkland Islands pages state the company provides data centre and enterprise solutions and advertises enterprise-class data centres for rack hosting/off-site backup with geographic redundancy in more than one Falklands location. Public source does not disclose MW, exact facility address, or build date; third-party hosting directory lists Sure South Atlantic at Ross Road, Port Stanley and nameserver IPs localized to Stanley.
